methods.summary: Compared independent vertical slices and their dependencies, then prioritized measurable context reduction and reliable execution while preserving approval and quality gates.
methods.reason: The Superpowers brainstorming skill was not discoverable as an invocable skill in this Codex session. The repository proposal-planning Skill and Prompt were read, and equivalent structured option analysis was recorded without claiming the unavailable skill was invoked.
questions: Which issue most directly reduces AI coding effectiveness? The Stage 04 context package is already at 8/8 groups, but the generator does not report expanded character count, so the 12,000-character target is not evidenced.

Which improvements can be accepted independently, and what must precede risk-tiered checks? Runtime reliability, measured context bundles, and canonical artifact generation are independent; risk profiles should depend on the approved tag and check catalog contracts.
alternatives: Deliver one large workflow rewrite versus four independently acceptable vertical slices; selected four slices to make value and regression boundaries reviewable.

Delete duplicate audit and handoff artifacts versus retain required evidence and generate derivative summaries from the canonical contract; selected canonical generation to preserve auditability while reducing repeated maintenance.
decisions: Propose reliable-gate-runtime, workflow-context-bundles, artifact-source-of-truth, and risk-tier-check-profiles as separate Changes; the first three are parallel candidates and risk-tier profiles depend on the context and artifact contracts.
Prioritize actual rendered context measurement and preserve all approval, baseline, evidence-integrity, and required independent-verification gates.
open_questions: User/product owner must approve roadmap ordering and the first Change before any OpenSpec Change is created.
Q-003 risk-tier criteria and check sets require technical/quality-owner review and an approved baseline amendment before implementation.

outputs.role: Prioritized, dependency-ordered roadmap for AI coding workflow optimization
Shared roadmap checker now scopes validation to the roadmap table instead of unrelated Markdown tables
